notes: Two fixes: (1) the native preview surface was being made visible immediately, before it had any video frame to show, which painted a stuck black box over the Featured banner on some TVs while it buffered - it now stays hidden until a real frame is ready, then fades in, so you see the still backdrop (not black) until the video actually starts. (2) Featured no longer picks 4K-tagged titles, since those are the heaviest to preview live - it lands on a regular title instead.
